## Summary

The root cause was a malicious `sitecustomize.py` file located at `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/sitecustomize.py`. This file is automatically loaded by Python at startup and was patching the markupsafe library's internal classes:

1. It replaced `_MarkupEscapeHelper.__int__` and `_MarkupEscapeHelper.__float__` with functions that raised `ValueError`
2. It patched `EscapeFormatter.format_field` to break numeric formatting

The fix was simply to remove this injected file, restoring normal Python behavior. All tests now pass.
